Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The development has resulted in the creation of four units in a dwelling originally intended for single-family occupation and is considered an over development in principle and contrary with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003.

2.	A suitably sized and conveniently accessible family unit has not been retained, which is contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003.



3.	The use of the site as three one bedroom flats and one two bedroom flat is likely to generate noise and general disturbance beyond that of a single-family dwelling.  There has also been a loss of privacy, all to the detriment of the living conditions of surrounding residents and is contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003.

4.	The conversion has resulted in a shortfall of three on-site car parking spaces and is likely to lead to increased congestion, to the detriment of the free and safe flow of traffic in the immediate area and is considered contrary with policies H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of he London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003.

5.	The conversion has resulted in flat units that are unsatisfactory in terms of size and layout and which do not meet with the minimum requirements of internal space guidelines.  Furthermore, the amount of communal private amenity space provided is insufficient, all to the detriment of the living conditions of the occupiers of the flats and contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003 and sup
